title: Kavya's mango pulp business
body: Kavya runs a small business in Ratnagiri that buys Alphonso mangoes from local orchards and turns them into pulp. The mangoes ripen only in April and May, but juice makers and sweet shops want pulp throughout the year. Kavya has hired refrigerated trucks to carry her cans of pulp to buyers in Mumbai and Pune. She keeps most of the season's pulp in a rented cold store and releases it month by month as orders arrive. To pay the orchard owners in cash during the short season, she uses a cash credit facility from her bank. She has insured the stock in the cold store against fire and theft. She also posts short videos on a social media page to tell bakeries and restaurants about her pulp, its quality and its price.
